trajectory.patch:
The Kconfig warning indicates a dependency issue with `CONFIG_MODEM_PPP`. It depends on `!CONFIG_NET_L2_PPP`, but the test's project configuration (`prj.conf`) enables both `CONFIG_MODEM_PPP` and `CONFIG_NET_L2_PPP`.

The test source code (`tests/subsys/modem/modem_ppp/src/main.c`) includes `<zephyr/net/ppp.h>` and uses data structures defined there, which are only available when `CONFIG_NET_L2_PPP` is enabled. This confirms that `CONFIG_NET_L2_PPP` is a necessary dependency for the `MODEM_PPP` module and its test.

The dependency `depends on !NET_L2_PPP` is incorrect and should be `depends on NET_L2_PPP`. Correcting this in `subsys/modem/Kconfig` will resolve the Kconfig warning.

This change will correctly enable `CONFIG_MODEM_PPP`, which in turn will cause the modem PPP module's source code to be compiled. This will resolve all the "undefined reference" linker errors for `modem_ppp_*` functions. The `select` statements within the `MODEM_PPP` Kconfig option will also correctly pull in dependencies like `MODEM_PIPE` and `CRC`, resolving the remaining linker errors for `modem_pipe_*` and `crc16_ccitt` functions.

subsys/modem/Kconfig
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
config MODEM_PPP
	bool "Modem PPP module"
	depends on !NET_L2_PPP
========
config MODEM_PPP
	bool "Modem PPP module"
	depends on NET_L2_PPP
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
